notes.title: Golden Vale's Legacy Release On & Hot Time Event
notes.notes:
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/d3c45d7b6ded6182c39d630ab85e26f03a2f8c32.png"][/img]Dear CEOs,[/p][p]The On and Hot Time event, scheduled during Golden Vale's Legacy Release On & Hot Time Event, is as follows. [/p][p]Please read carefully to use all vital buffs to enhance your company. [/p][p]
[b]◆ On-time Event Schedule[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sept. 24, 10:00 - Sept. 30, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]◆ On-Time Event Gift[/b][/p][list][*][p]300,000 Credit[/p][/*][*][p]5,000 Eternium[/p][/*][*][p]3 Simulation Training Permits[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]◆ How to Participate in the On-Time Event[/b][/p][list][*][p]Event gifts will be given to your mailbox every day upon login.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]◆ Hot Time Event Buff[/b][/p][p]1) Sept. 23, 10:00 - Sept. 30, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]▷ 20% Decreased Credit Cost on Employee Negotiations[/p][p]▷ 20% Decreased Eternium Cost on Battles[/p][p]
 [b]\[Note][/b][/p][p]- CEOs can only receive the On-Time event gift once a day.[/p][p]- The On-Time event gift will be deleted when the valid period expires. Please receive it within this period.[/p][p]- You can check the applied Hot Time effect by clicking the Hot Time buff image next to the nickname on the lobby screen.[/p][p][/p][p]------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]This concludes the On-Time & Hot Time event details for this week.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

New Substream : Omen1 - Golden Vale's Legacy [/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://i.imgur.com/rZoK5W4.png"][/img]1) New Substream \[Omen1 - Golden Vale’s Legacy] will be added.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]2. Unlimited Season 3[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/idQaysw.png"][/img][b]▼ Unlimited - Season 3 Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ Sept. 23, after the maintenance - Sept. 30, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p][b]▼ Unlimited - Settlement Period[/b][/p][p]▷ Sept. 30, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5) - Oct. 7, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Season Rules][/b][/p][p]- Users can compete with each other during the season.[/p][p]- This Week's Bans & Ups are not applied.[/p][p]- Users will earn more points for winning and lose fewer points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users will earn fewer points for winning and lose more points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.[/p][p]- When matched against an opponent with a Victory Point difference above a certain threshold, the maximum or minimum possible Victory Points could be earned or lost.[/p][p]- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users in Bronze – Diamond League will not lose Victory Points upon losing.[/p][p]- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted from their League if their Victory Points go below the league's minimum point requirement by 1 or more.[/p][p]- 50 points will be deducted during the Settlement period if 48 hours have passed since the last match, and 50 points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The point deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to 150 points or lower.[/p][p]- Matches will be unavailable during the Victory Point Settlement period, between 00:00–06:00 (UTC+9) every day.[/p][p]- Rewards will be given based on the final Victory Points once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Unlimited Combat Environment][/b][/p][p]- Only 10% of HP, ATK, and DEF increased from gear and growth is applied.[/p][p]- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit are applied to SSR ships.[/p][p]- Outgoing Healing Decrease reaches up to 80% depending on the remaining time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ Participation Reward[/b][/p][p]Play Unlimited 1 time every day - 1 Event Random Box[/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ Season Reward[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/iCZlBtn.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ Rank Reward[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/1GsyIPC.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Frame: Unlimited S3][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/AFqmKnc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Title: Season 3 Unlimited TOP 1][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/iYtWWN5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Title: Season 3 Unlimited TOP 2][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/EufYiIE.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Title: Season 3 Unlimited TOP 3][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/3ySg20z.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Title: Season 3 Unlimited TOP 10][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/1SohcGV.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Title: Season 3 Unlimited TOP 100][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/8o8kFIl.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]3. Gauntlet[/b][/h2][h3][b]▣ Ranked Battle[/b][/h3][p]1) The 2025 Courageous Season will end..[/p][p][b]▷ End Schedule:[/b] Sept. 28, 2025, at 08:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][b]▷ Settlement Schedule:[/b] Sept. 28, 08:00 - Sept. 28, 2025, 14:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p]※ 2025 Courageous Season’s Limited Skin is \[Empress of the End World - Replacer Queen].[/p][p]※ If you already have the skin, you will get a Frame: Shrouded Tragedy.[/p][p][/p][p]2) The 2025 Sincere season will start.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ Schedule[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Sept. 28, 14:00 - Dec. 28, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p]※ The skin rewards for the 2025 Sincere Season will be announced at a later date.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]4. Raid: Inhibitor Season[/b][/h2][p]The raid boss \[Inhibitor] will appear.
The raid boss \[Inhibitor] will be available during the season period.[/p][p][/p][p][b] Raid Schedule[/b][/p][p][/p][p]▷ Sept. 23, after the maintenance - Oct. 7, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p]※ With the season rotation for [b]\[Inhibitor],[/b] the Plaque Exchange[b] [/b]rewards will be updated.[/p][p]※ [b]Raid Points[/b] will only be awarded from raid bosses generated during the ongoing season. Defeating raid bosses from other seasons will only grant clear rewards.[/p][p]※ Only the [b]\[Struggle] Origin [/b]will be applied to the raid boss[b] \[Inhibitor][/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]5. Challenge Stage: Knights of Redemption Exclusive Gear - \[Nights of Redemption][/b][/h2][p]1) The Night of Redemption Challenge Mode will return.
[/p][p][b] ◆ Schedule [/b][/p][p][/p][p]▷ Sept. 23, 2025, after the maintenance - Sept. 30, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ [/b] [b]Dungeon Composition[/b][/p][p]- Consists of ACT.1–3 stages.[/p][p]- Each act is divided into three stages, each with a different combat concept.
- In Challenge Mode, a new exclusive buff \[Night of Redemption] will be added, increasing the stats of deployed Knight of Redemption employees.
[/p][p][b]◆ Rewards[/b][/p][p]- Clear Challenge Mode to obtain \[Knights of Redemption Medal], a material required to craft \[Knight of Redemption]  Mold.
 ※ Rewards can only be obtained upon victory.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ci1NRAi.png"][/img][/p][p]- When clearing Challenge Mode stages, you can obtain both a First Clear Reward and a Medal Completion Reward (for achieving 3 medals), and you can also earn \[Knights of Redemption Medal] as repeat rewards.[/p][p]- The \[Knights of Redemption Medal] obtained upon victory in Challenge Mode can be used to craft Knight of Redemption  Molds.
[/p][p][b]※ Challenge Stage Rewards[/b][/p][p]First Clear Reward: Knights of Redemption Medal
Medal Completion Reward: Quartz
Repeat Reward (Stage Drop): Knights of Redemption Medal[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/pHmZR1L.png"][/img][/p][p]- When a new employee is added to the team eligible for molds, new Exclusive Gear for that employee will also be added to each Exclusive Gear Mold.[/p][p][/p][p][b]◆ Exclusive Gear[/b][/p][p]- You can craft from \[Workshop] > \[Craft] > \[Exclusive Gear] tab.[/p][p]- Click the Exclusive Gear Mold icon for \[Knights of Redemption] to view the available list.[/p][p]- To craft \[Knights of Redemption] Molds, you will need \[Credits], \[Knights of Redemption Medal], and \[Elite Gear Materials].[/p][p]- The crafting method is the same as with existing molds, and crafting is completed instantly.
- The list of craftable Exclusive Gear is as follows.
- When clearing Challenge stages, there is a low chance of obtaining a completed Knights of Redemption Exclusive Gear.[/p][p]- When dismantling Knights of Redemption Exclusive Gear, you will receive 50 Knights of Redemption Medals.
 ※ Exclusive Gear obtained through mold crafting or stage clears is identical to the Exclusive Gear acquired via Counter Case.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/9NmGdej.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]6. Punch-In[/b][/h2][h3][b]◈ Anastasia’s Special Supplies[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Od62CLz.png"][/img]1) Anastasia’s Special Supplies Punch-In will start.[/p][p][/p][p][b] ◆ Schedule[/b][/p][p]- Sept. 23, 2025, after the maintenance - Oct. 7, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p]※ During the event period, you can participate in a total of 7 days of attendance check-ins.[/p][p]※ Attendance check-ins reset every day at 14:00 (UTC-5).[/p][p]※ Consecutive check-ins are not required—simply check in for the total number of days within the period to receive all rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[ List of Rewards ][/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/WLdTq2x.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]7. Recruitment[/b][/h2][p]1. Three Classified Recruitments will return.
- Schedule: Sept. 23, after the maintenance - Oct. 7, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)
- Ensured Recruitment Count: 150 times
- One employee is ensured to appear within the 150 recruitments.
- Once an Ensured Employee is obtained, the counter will be reset.[/p][p]- Target employee: 【 Cold Case Horizon 】【 Zodiac of Redemption Esterosa de Chevalier 】【 Final Phase Sigma 】[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/dbGz6KU.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/cQQ0ngH.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/gLfjWpK.png"][/img][/p][p]2. Three Normal Recruitment Chance UP will return.
- Schedule: Sept. 23, after the maintenance - Oct. 7, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p]- Ensured Recruitment Count: 150 times
- One employee is ensured to appear within the 150 recruitments.
- Once an Ensured Employee is obtained, the counter will be reset.[/p][p]- Target employee: 【 Lucrecia 】【 Lyudmila 】【 Horizon 】[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/TDXiGjz.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/iowUC38.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/j7aPb5T.png"][/img][/p][p]3) Seosaeng has been added to the Recruit on Demand pool.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]8. Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2][p]1) Improved so that Awakened Exclusive Gear will not be displayed when selecting the Relic Gear filter.[/p][p]2) Improved so that after a Friendly Match ends, if there is no input for a certain period of time on the result screen, the game will automatically return to the Friendly Match lobby.[/p][p]3) Improved so that when a skin is worn, the applied skin will be displayed in the Kill Log.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]9. Fixes[/b][/h2][p]1) Fixed an issue where Iron Knight Curian’s Ultimate skill occasionally triggered the deployment motion.[/p][p]2) Fixed an issue where some of the Gear Selection Coupons can not be used as intended.[/p][p]3) Fixed an issue where the CP of Awakened employees obtained through some selection coupons were displayed abnormally.[/p][p][/p][p]------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]This concludes the update details for this week.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p]

Oct. 14, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]◆ Clearing Counter Pass[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can clear the Counter Pass Missions to increase the pass level while acquiring the necessary materials for unit growth.[/p][/*][*][p]Counter Pass missions are divided into \[Daily Mission] and \[Weekly Missions].[/p][/*][*][p]In the \[Daily Mission], 10 missions are given daily; you can choose 6 from the 10 to complete the given mission.[/p][list][*][p]If you don't like the mission given, you can select the reroll option to renew it.[/p][/*][*][p]You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.[/p][/*][*][p]If you clear more than 6 missions, you can earn extra pass experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In the \[Weekly Mission], 10 missions are given every Sunday at 14:00 UTC-5.[/p][list][*][p]You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can earn extra pass experience by completing the 2nd and 4th-week missions.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]  [/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Awakened Exclusive Gear - Tenured President Regina MacCready[/b][/p][p align="start"]- Four pieces of exclusive gear for Tenured President Regina MacCready will be added.  [/p][p align="start"]- Tenured President Regina MacCready’s exclusive gear will be added to the Frozen Corridors Substream event shop.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]- Gear can be obtained with a certain probability by clearing Frozen Corridors – Hard Mode ACT 1-2.  [/p][p align="start"]- You will obtain \[Awakened Exclusive Gear Part -Regina MacCready-] when dismantling the Tenured President Regina MacCready's Awakened exclusive gear.  [/p][p align="start"]- This item can be used for the Awakened Exclusive Gear Coupon -Regina MacCready- that will be added to the Frozen Corridors Substream event shop.  [/p][p align="start"]- At +2 enhancement, a Latent Ability will be unlocked.  [/p][p align="start"]- The Latent Ability is fixed as Ranged DMG, but the value is determined randomly.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/18e89656a605ee011e74f0b7b3098a584eb69813.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/06972e595d5f3e24cbc455c570538deb283d9a45.png"][/img] [/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Last Stand[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]\[ Season 15 ][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/3327c01b4f698537e7e2e726e70bf94b15ca9a83.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]1. Last Stand Season 15 will begin.[/p][p align="start"] - In Last Stand, there is no time limit, and the battle continues until your ship is destroyed.[/p][p align="start"]- As the battle progresses, stronger enemies will appear.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b] Last Stand Season 15 Schedule[/b][/p][p align="start"]▷ Sept. 9, 20:00 - Sept. 16, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b] Last Stand Season 15 Settlement Schedule[/b][/p][p align="start"]▷ Sept. 16, 20:00 - Sept. 24, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]\[Enemies and Kill Points][/b][/p][p align="start"]- [b]Regularly Appearing Enemies:[/b] Stronger enemies appear at regular intervals. [/p][p align="start"]- [b]Earning Kill Points:[/b] Earn Kill Points by eliminating monsters depending on their level.[/p][p align="start"]- [b]Rank Placement Priority:[/b] In the event of a tie in Kill Points, the user who registered their rank first will be ranked higher. [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]\[Employee Deployment][/b][/p][p align="start"]- [b]Deployment Range Increase:[/b] All ally employees have increased deployment ranges. [/p][p align="start"]- [b]Deployment Restrictions: [/b]Each employee can only be deployed 1 time. [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]\[Difficulty Increase Over Time][/b][/p][p align="start"]- [b]Hitstun Immunity:[/b] All enemy units gain Immunity to Hitstun 1 minute after the battle starts. [/p][p align="start"]- [b]Outgoing Healing Decrease (1st):[/b] All units are inflicted with Outgoing Healing -60% 1 minute 30 seconds after the battle starts. [/p][p align="start"]- [b]Outgoing Healing Decrease (2nd):[/b] All units are inflicted with Outgoing Healing -80% 2 minutes after the battle starts. [/p][p align="start"]- [b]DMG Increase:[/b] Enemy units' damage increases by 100% 2 minutes 30 seconds after the battle starts.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]< Combat Environment >[/b][/p][p align="start"]1. Sure Fire to all enemy units, EVA and CRIT stats fixed to 0.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b] Elimination Score Reward[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/e89f6475489050e2514bfb7765ce64d79caa0159.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b] Rank Reward[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/9c914b2757bc074472074dcf5d59ca6480cb36b1.png"][/img] [/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Raid: Britra Season[/b][/p][p align="start"]The raid boss \[Britra] will appear. The raid boss \[Britra] will be available during the season period.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b] Raid Schedule[/b][/p][p align="start"]▷ Sept. 9, 20:00 - September 23, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]※ With the season rotation for [b]\[Britra],[/b] the Plaque Exchange[b] [/b]rewards will be updated.[/p][p align="start"]※ [b]Raid Points[/b] will only be awarded from raid bosses generated during the ongoing season. Defeating raid bosses from other seasons will only grant clear rewards.[/p][p align="start"]※ Only the [b]\[Struggle] Origin [/b]will be applied to the raid boss[b] \[Britra][/b].[/p][p align="start"]  [/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Challenge Stage[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]【 Let's Go, A.R.S.! 】[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The White Rabbit Exclusive Gear Challenge Mode, “Let's Go, A.R.S.!” will return.  [/p][p align="start"][b] Challenge Stage - Let’s Go, A.R.S.! Available Schedule [/b][/p][p align="start"]▷ Sept. 9, after the maintenance - Sept. 16, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [b]Dungeon Composition[/b][/p][p align="start"]- Consists of ACT.1–3 stages.[/p][p align="start"]- Each act is divided into three stages, each with a different combat concept. - In Challenge Mode, a new exclusive buff for White Rabbit will be added, increasing the stats of deployed White Rabbit units.  [/p][p align="start"][b]Rewards[/b][/p][p align="start"]Clear Challenge Mode to obtain \[HP Potions], a material required to craft White Rabbit  Mold.  ※ Rewards can only be obtained upon victory.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/9852366299659946f9f2aa40888299016a9aa87e.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]When clearing Challenge Mode stages, you can obtain both a First Clear Reward and a Medal Completion Reward (for achieving 3 medals), and you can also earn \[HP Potions] as repeat rewards.  [/p][p align="start"]The \[HP Potions] obtained upon victory in Challenge Mode can be used to craft White Rabbit Molds.  [/p][p align="start"][b]※ Challenge Stage Rewards[/b][/p][p align="start"]First Clear Reward: HP Potion Medal Completion Reward: Quartz Repeat Reward (Stage Drop): HP Potion[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/3325b837a89c1581c3c6f3cb6fb3d0b9788ef162.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b] Contents of \[ White Rabbit ] Mold[/b][/p][p align="start"]- You can craft from \[Workshop] > \[Craft] > \[Exclusive Gear] tab.[/p][p align="start"]- Click the Exclusive Gear Mold icon for \[White Rabbit] to view the available list.[/p][p align="start"]- To craft \[White Rabbit] Molds, you will need \[Credits], \[HP Potions], and \[Elite Gear Materials].[/p][p align="start"]- The crafting method is the same as with existing molds, and crafting is completed instantly. - The list of craftable Exclusive Gear is as follows[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]* The mold will give a random exclusive gear from these three gears listed above.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/1a1ea92699cf7e687574d8d406e71e90b87bf2dd.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Punch-In Event[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]【 Company Reinforcement Season 】[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/24df39597f127d299ace682bc43a9d702072f3e8.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Company Reinforcement Season will start. [/p][p align="start"][b] Company Reinforcement Season Punch-in  Schedule[/b][/p][p align="start"]▷ Sept. 9, after the maintenance - Sept. 23, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]※ During the event period, you can participate in a total of 7 days of attendance check-ins.[/p][p align="start"]※ Attendance check-ins reset every day at 14:00 (UTC-5).[/p][p align="start"]※ Consecutive check-ins are not required—simply check in for the total number of days within the period to receive all rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]\[ List of Rewards ][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/9856114a38ff355b96278208741b6324bd2d9c77.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Returning Awakened Employees[/b][/p][p align="start"]1. Three Classified Recruitments will return. - Schedule: Sept. 9, after the maintenance - Sept. 23, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5) - Ensured Recruitment Count: 150 times - One employee is ensured to appear within the 150 recruitments. - Once an Ensured Employee is obtained, the counter will be reset.[/p][p align="start"][b]- [/b]Target employee: [b]【 Solar Codex Yuna Springfield 】【 Exorcist Lucia Ridge 】【 Six Wings Na Yubin 】[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/2f8417f25789f1090da0273ff489895033a053b0.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/969ade41ea35539aac7f7b262a23187f52c391eb.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756813/210f1b9c55f3282fed5d3449278ae0f7dd974781.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]▣ Returning Employees[/b][/p][p align="start"]1. notes.title: [September 3] Server Patch
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/xev6SJJ.png"][/img]
A server patch will be applied on September 3, 2025. [/p][p align="start"]During the patch, there may be brief interruptions. After the announced time, you will be able to log in, and the data patch will be downloaded and applied.[/p][p align="start"]For more details, please refer to the information below to ensure a smooth gameplay experience.[/p][p align="start"]
[b]▣ Server Patch Schedule[/b]
-  September 3, 01:00 - 01:10 (UTC-5) 

[b]▣ Effect[/b]
[/p][p align="start"]- Brief interruptions during the patch.

[b]▣ Content[/b]
- Server stabilization. 
[/p][p align="start"][b]\[Note][/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p]The schedule may change depending on the patch situation. Any changes will be announced through this notice.
[/p][/*][*][p]Reconnecting may require data usage to download the patch, so we recommend using Wi-Fi.[/p][/*][/list]

[/p][p][b]◆ Participation Method[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]\[Team Relay][/b][/p][p]- Select one of the two teams to root for with Sneakers.[/p][p]- If the team you selected wins, you can obtain the reward according to the reward multiplier.[/p][p]- Races are held once per day, and you will not be able to participate during the settling period.[/p][p]

[/p][p]- The daily settlement period is from 13:50 ~ 14:10 (UTC-5), and you will not be able to use your \[Sneakers]. [/p][p]- After the settlement period, you will be able to select your daily team and use your \[Sneakers].[/p][p]- You will be able to check the result after the settlement period, and if your selected team wins the match, you will be able to acquire the reward. [/p][p]- If you have participated in the match the day before, you can rewatch the match via \[Previous Race Replay].[/p][p]- You can select \[History] to view your participation history, including match result, rooted team, reward multiplier, and acquired reward for each participation.[/p][p]- The match will not proceed after September 1, 14:00 (UTC-5), and you cannot select the team and use the sneakers on the match.[/p][p]- You can exchange Sneakers at the Team Relay Event Shop for various rewards and a title.[/p][p]

[p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdCCj053Z66PiW1ys-beBFB0z06E3IJcmHF2RJI3X14p9zuwzpKEeLTXmDkfls74dfC69KdtgtwqqTig7tsTjlCYUh9tS1N4nhULdDpYqokJUpHAROfemC-84FpRV-ErhO2E8I?key=swKfJW06RAZE0-LxFk1-cg"][/img][/p][p]Dear CEOs,[/p][p]The Patch Notes for August 12 is now live![/p][p]Please review the details below to ensure you don't miss any vital update information.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]▼ Maintenance Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷  August 12, 20:00 - 22:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p]

[/p][p][b]▣ Unlimited Season 2[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdhJkFXETeeWm2GDTyi8i7nzVxqD9hWIngc3iaRpxBGGD62YdG1GBTc4q7hW4M_gOq5UrbhtfWIf746l9ocUVnq3NvvEoRKvHNYZc9EzaSDtgcA8OSoerRzAwkVTf4Ogn1u9vXl?key=swKfJW06RAZE0-LxFk1-cg"][/img][/p][p][b]▼ Unlimited - Season 2 Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ Aug. 12, after the maintenance - Aug. 19, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]\[Season Rules][/b][/p][p]- Users can compete with each other during the season.[/p][p]- This Week's Bans & Ups are not applied.[/p][p]- Users will earn more Victory Points for winning and lose less Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users will earn less Victory Points for winning and lose more Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.[/p][p]- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users in Bronze do not lose their Victory Points after losing.[/p][p]- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted if they reach 1 or lower Victory Points below the required Victory Points of that League.[/p][p]- 50 Victory Points will be deducted during the Settlement period if no match was played 48 hours after the last match, and 50 Victory Points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The Victory Points deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to 200 Victory Points or lower.[/p][p]- Matches will be unavailable during the Victory Point Settlement period, between 00:00–11:00(UTC+9) every day.[/p][p]- Rewards will be given based on the final Victory Points once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]\[Unlimited Combat Environment][/b][/p][p]- Only 10% of HP, ATK, and DEF increased from gear and growth are applied.[/p][p]- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit applied to SSR ships.[/p][p]- Outgoing Healing Decrease reaches up to 80% depending on the remaining time.[/p][p]

notes.title: [ July 29 ] Patch Notes (Extended)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdXzsBwL_oUKEZi7rTUhbaM2Y9tOv9B_j1FtvCzxM9t2WXAxBBPhra-HmpN4R7g5GYsfWwU_juTcfdmSv7FoEsdNApmq89xQyGc5oTEJEYgvdTXMVZMxcz2IsOxj-9fuwtqkNyy?key=kKoz2UnnVyD8BE1TxIDYHA"][/img][/p][p]Dear CEOs,[/p][p]The Patch Notes for July 29 is now live![/p][p]Please review the details below to ensure you don't miss any vital update information.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]▼ Maintenance Schedule - 2 hrs extension[/b][/p][p]▷  July 29, 20:00 - July 30, 00:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]▼ Shop News[/b][/p][p]For this week’s update on shop products, please check the announcement below for more information.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Shop Product[/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1976440/view/503957423211422939"]\[LINK][/url][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]▣ Squad Tournament The Worlds[/b][/p][p]Squad Tournament The Worlds between Korean and Global servers will begin. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcYr6QzrvMRZYWbVOyZ7MRNdICq8oXAxhsk9BGJHbZrdnDt8gjTaQ9uNI94P0N2QroKVaYVTs12gjUMLhSEjh4Y7V69T9Oes0XkBx7Pl0C0wdqHvf-EF-5aHvRjK9759NPmrNEbDA?key=kKoz2UnnVyD8BE1TxIDYHA"][/img][/p][p][b]▼ Squad Tournament The Worlds Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ July 29, after the maintenance - Aug. 19, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]◆ Global Ban Vote[/b][/p][list][*][p]During the ban voting period, CEOs can select the \[Vote] button to cast their CEO's vote for the ban.

[/p][/*][*][p]The top 8 employees with the most votes and 4 randomly selected employees among those who received votes will be chosen as casting ban targets.

[/p][/*][*][p]The top 3 ships with the most votes and 1 randomly selected ship among those that received votes will be chosen as casting ban targets.

[/p][/*][*][p]Employees and ships selected for the casting ban cannot be assigned to squads.

[/p][/*][*][p]Casting bans will be conducted separately on the Korean and Global servers, and both ban results will be applied.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ Voting Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ [b]July 29, after the maintenance - July 30, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p][b]◆ Squad Formation & Participation Registration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Once the casting ban targets are selected, CEOs can form squads to participate in the Squad Tournament.

[/p][/*][*][p]Completing the squad formation will complete the Squad Tournament registration.

[/p][/*][*][p]Squads participating in the tournament must have a Combat Power exceeding 100,000 to be registered.

[/p][/*][*][p]Gear, level, and limit break will be saved based on the registration time. The squad can be freely changed until the tournament begins.

[/p][/*][*][p]Any changes made to ships, operators, or employees after registration will be indicated with a \[changed] tag for easier tracking.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ Squad Formation Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ July 30, 16:00 - Aug. 3, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)

[/p][p][b]◆ Qualifiers[/b][/p][list][*][p]After squad registration closes, the qualifiers will begin. In the tournament lobby, CEOs can enter through the \[Enter Tournament] option.

[/p][/*][*][p]Before the qualifiers begin, CEOs can enter to review the Squad Tournament qualifier rules.

[/p][/*][*][p]Qualifiers will proceed at set intervals, and once completed, results can be checked via the \[Qualifier Results] option.

[/p][/*][*][p]CEOs can view opponent squad compositions via \[Details] and watch replays of matches.

[/p][/*][*][p]Participants who win their matches advance to the Elimination Tournament.

[/p][/*][*][p]Participants without an opponent will walkover by default.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ Qualifiers Schedule[/b][/p][p]▷ Aug. 5, 04:00 - Aug. 5, 2025, 05:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][p][b]◆ Elimination Tournament[/b][/p][list][*][p]Participants who win in the qualifiers advance to the Eliminations and will be assigned to groups.

[/p][/*][*][p]16 qualified participants will be selected from each server.

[/p][/*][*][p]Each group will have 4 participants from each server, matched against participants from another server.

[/p][/*][*][p]The matches will proceed sequentially by Groups A/B/C/D.

[/p][/*][*][p]CEOs can view squad details for each match using the \[Details] option.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Check match results by clicking \[Check Results].[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Group stage winners will advance to the Semifinals, and Semifinal winners will advance to the Final.

[/p][/*][*][p]The match results will be revealed once the predictions for each group end.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]■ Prediction[/b][/p][list][*][p]From the Elimination Tournament onward, CEOs can predict the winner of each match by selecting the \[Predict].

[/p][/*][*][p]Tap the \[Predict] button at the bottom of the screen to select a predicted winner for each match. All matches must be predicted to complete the prediction successfully.

[/p][/*][*][p]If CEOs attempt to save without completing all predictions, a message will inform that predictions are incomplete.

[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards will be granted based on the number of successful predictions after the tournament concludes.

[/p][/*][*][p]Tap the \[Prediction Statistics] button at the bottom of the screen to view overall prediction statistics.

[/p][/*][*][p]After each group's prediction period ends, the \[Predict] button will change to \[Prediction History], where CEOs can review the choices.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ Prediction Schedule[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Group A[/b]: Aug. 6, 05:00 - Aug. 7, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B[/b]: Aug. 6, 05:00 - Aug. 8, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C[/b]: Aug. 6, 05:00 - Aug. 9, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group D[/b]: Aug. 6, 05:00 - Aug. 10, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]◆ Knockout Stage[/b][/p][list][*][p]Participants who win in each group advance to the Knockout Stage for Semifinals and Finals matches.

[/p][/*][*][p]Semifinal winners advance to the Final.

[/p][/*][*][p]The Final match winner will be the Tournament Winner.

[/p][/*][*][p]Semifinal losers will compete for 3rd and 4th place, which will be decided based on match results.

[/p][/*][*][p]Once the prediction period ends, CEOs can view match results.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ Knockout Stage Prediction Schedule[/b][/p][list][*][p]Aug. 10, 04:10 -Aug. 11, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]■ Hall of Fame[/b][/p][list][*][p]CEOs can view the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place CEOs of past tournaments via the \[Hall of Fame] button in the Squad Tournament lobby.

[/p][/*][*][p]The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place CEOs of this season will be listed in the Hall of Fame.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]■ Participation Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]During the Squad Tournament rewards period, select the \[Participation Rewards] button in the lobby to claim CEOsr rewards.

[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards can be obtained based on tournament participation and final rankings.

[/p][/*][*][p]Additional rewards can be earned based on the number of successful predictions made during the Eliminations and Knockout Stage.

[/p][p][b]\[ Championship ][/b][/p][p]- Users can compete with each other during the season.[/p][p]- This Week's Bans & Ups are not applied.[/p][p]- Users will earn more points for winning and lose fewer points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users will earn fewer points for winning and lose more points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.[/p][p]- When matched against an opponent with a Victory Point difference above a certain threshold, the maximum or minimum possible Victory Points could be earned or lost.[/p][p]- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.[/p][p]- Users in Bronze – Diamond League will not lose Victory Points upon losing.[/p][p]- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted from their League if their Victory Points go below the league's minimum point requirement by 1 or more.[/p][p]- 50 points will be deducted during the Settlement period if 48 hours have passed since the last match, and 50 points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The point deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period.  [/p][h3][b]▣ Challenge Stage[/b][/h3][p][b]【 Old Administration Training Method 】[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdWGlqbECkWXemLI3yXszyC8fL53N71Mw9zTe8zeAX_H-MhrOFKGXrrPqRL-hrl5xxtMBGhW3pYuGT0god0D7k42rCGgSNiFcxZWGJOUu7T7UBWE437cihMRrfMjpgh48WYfz3o-A?key=IhxHehW2eI4aR_VRL24IYw"][/img][/p][p]The Old Administration Training Method challenge stage will open to create exclusive gear for Old Administration: Counter employees.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the challenge, you can get [b]\[ Old Administration Pass ] [/b]which you can use to craft Exclusive Gear. Moreover, there is a slight chance for the full exclusive gear to drop after a successful run.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]▼ Crafting \[ Old Administration: Counter ] Mold[/b][/p][p]To craft with \[ Old Administration: Counter ] Mold, you need:[/p][p]- 2,500,000 Credits[/p][p]- 400 Old Administration Passes[/p][p]- 600 Advanced Gear materials[/p][p]

 [/p][h3][b]▣ Invincibility Effect Update[/b][/h3][p]The invincibility effect policy will be updated.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ Immune to DMG with Visual Effects[/b][/p][list][*][p]When Immune to DMG is triggered under a non-damaging Stun or Sleep effect, the Stun/Sleep effect will be removed, while Immune to DMG remains active.[/p][/*][*][p]When a non-damaging Stun or Sleep effect is applied to a unit already under Immune to DMG, the unit will stagger, and the Stun/Sleep effect will be removed, while Immune to DMG remains active.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]* [/b]Other status effects such as Freeze, Bind, and Confusion will not be removed.
[b] * [/b]Under Immune to DMG, employees cannot be hit by enemy attacks, so status effects that involve damage will not be applied.
[b] *[/b] If Immune to DMG is triggered during a damaging Stun or Sleep effect, that effect will be removed. (This behavior remains unchanged.)
[b] *[/b] This clarification of the Immune to DMG policy applies only to non-damaging Stun or Sleep effects, such as those caused by Command Skills like Asha or Chloe Starseeker. It does not apply to impacts inflicted through attacks.[/p][p][b]■ Immune to damage State (No Visual Effect)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Grants complete immunity to all types of damage and status effects (including those labeled as "cannot be canceled").[/p][/*][*][p]Unless otherwise noted, this state is applied for a certain duration during Ultimate Skill activation.[/p][/*][/list][p]
 [/p][h3][b]▣ Summer Season Circuit Link Event[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeHZnfzTaQCXIzrfjzaNhongr8yPODC0AAbyWwv1BLbRD2PVa6A9sZt5ZKFA4PzsK4w1CMChKrqvLSbkRUWbduKNVGGEc633Ari2AMSkcOxvIf6eDlWfJRjDuI92jrVhE4o3EG2uA?key=-xhm3sOLfWiBLR_JDzyqTw"][/img][/p][p]- In content that consumes Eternium, such as Main Stream (excluding EP.1 on Normal difficulty) and Substream (excluding Supplements), you can obtain \[Summer Record] as a battle reward based on a set probability.
- One \[Summer Record] allows you to draw one bingo number.
- If you draw a duplicate number, 1 Mileage Point will be accumulated. You can spend 10 Mileage Points to draw a guaranteed number.
- Completing a row grants a line reward, and accumulating completed bingo lines will grant milestone rewards.
- The four center bingo tiles can be unlocked by completing \[Analysis Missions].
- Each \[Summer Record] can be exchanged for 1,000 Circuit Link Exchange Shop credits.[/p][p]

[b][Season Rules][/b]

- Users can compete with each other during the season.

- This Week's Bans & Ups are not applied.

- Users will earn more Victory Points for winning and lose less Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.

- Users will earn fewer Victory Points for winning and lose more Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.

- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.

- Users in Bronze do not lose their Victory Points after losing.

- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted if they reach 1 or fewer Victory Points below the required Victory Points of that League.

- 50 Victory Points will be deducted during the Settlement period if no match was played 48 hours after the last match, and 50 Victory Points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The Victory Points deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to 200 Victory Points or lower.

- Matches will be unavailable during the Victory Point Settlement period, between 00:00–11:00(UTC+9) every day.

- Rewards will be given based on the final Victory Points once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.

[b][Unlimited Combat Environment][/b]

- Only 10% of HP, ATK, and DEF increased from gears and growth applied.

- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit applied to SSR ships.

[h2]▣ Squad Tournament The Worlds[/h2]
Squad Tournament The Worlds between Korean and Global servers will begin. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8gVQx3j.png[/img]
▼ Squad Tournament The Worlds Schedule
▷ May 6, after the maintenance - May 27, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)

[h3]◆ Global Ban Vote[/h3]
[list][*]
During the ban voting period, CEOs can select the [Vote] button to cast their CEO's vote for the ban.

[/*][*]
The top 3 employees with the most votes and 3 randomly selected employees among those who received votes will be chosen as casting ban targets.

[/*][*]
The top 2 ships with the most votes and 1 randomly selected ship among those that received votes will be chosen as casting ban targets.

[/*][*]
Employees and ships selected for the casting ban cannot be assigned to squads.

[/*][*]
Casting bans will be conducted separately on the Korean and Global servers, and both ban results will be applied.  
[/*][/list]

[b]▼ Voting Schedule[/b]
▷ May 6, after the maintenance -[b] May 7, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)[/b]
 

[h3]◆ Squad Formation & Participation Registration[/h3]
[list][*]
Once the casting ban targets are selected, CEOs can form squads to participate in the Squad Tournament.


[/*][*]
Completing the squad formation will complete the Squad Tournament registration.


[/*][*]
Squads participating in the tournament must have a Combat Power exceeding 100,000 to be registered.


[/*][*]
Gear, level, and limit break will be saved based on the registration time. The squad can be freely changed until the tournament begins.


[/*][*]
Any changes made to ships, operators, or employees after registration will be indicated with a [changed] tag for easier tracking.  
[/*][/list]

[b]▼ Squad Formation Schedule[/b]
▷ May 7, 11:00 - May 12, 2025, 09:59 (UTC-5)  

[h3]◆ Qualifiers[/h3]
[list][*]
After squad registration closes, the qualifiers will begin. In the tournament lobby, CEOs can enter through the [Enter Tournament] option.


[/*][*]
Before the qualifiers begin, CEOs can enter to review the Squad Tournament qualifier rules.


[/*][*]
Qualifiers will proceed at set intervals, and once completed, results can be checked via the [Qualifier Results] option.


[/*][*]
CEOs can view opponent squad compositions via [Details] and watch replays of matches.


[/*][*]
Participants who win their matches advance to the Elimination Tournament.


[/*][*]
Participants without an opponent will walkover by default.  
[/*][/list]

[b]▼ Qualifiers Schedule[/b]
▷ May 14, 04:00 - May 14, 2025, 05:00 (UTC-5)  

[h3]◆ Elimination Tournament[/h3]
[list][*]
Participants who win in the qualifiers advance to the Eliminations and will be assigned to groups.


[/*][*]
16 qualified participants will be selected from each server.


[/*][*]
Each group will have 4 participants from each server, matched against participants from another server.


[/*][*]
The matches will proceed sequentially by Groups A/B/C/D.


[/*][*]
CEOs can view squad details for each match using the [Details] option.
[/*][/list]


[list][*]
Check match results by clicking [Check Results].
[/*][/list]


[list][*]
Group stage winners will advance to the Semifinals, and Semifinal winners will advance to the Final.


[/*][*]
The match results will be revealed once the predictions for each group end.  
[/*][/list]

[h3]■ Prediction[/h3]
[list][*]
From the Elimination Tournament onward, CEOs can predict the winner of each match by selecting the [Predict].


[/*][*]
Tap the [Predict] button at the bottom of the screen to select a predicted winner for each match. All matches must be predicted to complete the prediction successfully.


[/*][*]
If CEOs attempt to save without completing all predictions, a message will inform that predictions are incomplete.


[/*][*]
Rewards will be granted based on the number of successful predictions after the tournament concludes.


[/*][*]
Tap the [Prediction Statistics] button at the bottom of the screen to view overall prediction statistics.


[/*][*]
After each group's prediction period ends, the [Predict] button will change to [Prediction History], where CEOs can review the choices.  
[/*][/list]

[b]▼ Prediction Schedule[/b]
[list][*]
Group A: May 14, 05:00 - May 15, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)


[/*][*]
Group B: May 14, 05:00 - May 16, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-5)

[/*][*]

[/*][/list]

[h3]◆ Knockout Stage[/h3]
[list][*]
Participants who win in each group advance to the Knockout Stage for Semifinals and Finals matches.


[/*][*]
Semifinal winners advance to the Final.


[/*][*]
The Final match winner will be the Tournament Winner.


[/*][*]
Semifinal losers will compete for 3rd and 4th place, which will be decided based on match results.


[/*][*]
Once the prediction period ends, CEOs can view match results.

[b][ Information ][/b]

[b][Championship][/b]

- Users can compete with each other during the season, and matches are played after setting a Global Ban.

- Users will earn more points for winning and lose fewer points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.

- Users will earn less points for winning and lose more points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.

- When matched against an opponent with a Victory Point difference above a certain threshold, the maximum or minimum possible Victory Points could be earned or lost.

- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.

- Users in Bronze – Diamond League will not lose Victory Points upon losing.

- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted from their League if their Victory Points go below the league's minimum point requirement by 1 or more.

- Forfeiting the match during the Pick & Ban phase will lead to a loss and more Victory Points will be deducted.

- When the opponent forfeits the match during the Pick & Ban phase, Victory Points will be awarded at a lower rate due to the default win.

- 50 points will be deducted during the Settlement period if 48 hours have passed since the last match, and 50 points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The point deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to 100 points or lower.

- Matches will be unavailable during the Victory Point Settlement period, between 10:00 – 21:00 (UTC-5) every day.

- Rewards will be given based on the final Victory Points once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.

[b][Championship Combat Environment][/b]

- Only 10% of HP, ATK, and DEF increased from gear and growth is applied.

- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit are applied to SSR ships.

- Outgoing Healing Decrease reaches up to 80% depending on the remaining time.

[h3]※ Excluding specific categories[/h3]

If the search item has ‘-’ in front, the one with the - will not be included in the search range.

> Example 1. [ Striker -SSR ] will return Strikers of N, R, and SR rarity.


 

[h3]※ Multi-Condition Search Function[/h3]

Typing in space in between or slash will allow multi-condition search.

For example, typing in [ T7 +7 ] will result in all T7 gears with level 7 enhancement level.


 

[h3]※ Stat Search Range Limitations[/h3]

If you enter > and <, you can search gears with specific values above or below that specified value. 

Example 1. Latent Skill Haste>10 will return all gears with Latent Skill Haste stat equal to and above 10%.

Example 2. Latent Skill Haste>10 ASPD Set will return all gears with Latent Skill Haste stat equal to and above 10% and with a set effect of ASPD.

▼ Unlimited - Season Beta Schedule
▷ March 11, after the maintenance - April 1, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)

[h3][Season Rules][/h3]
- Users can compete with each other during the season.

- This Week's Bans & Ups are not applied.

- Users will earn more Victory Points for winning and lose less Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.

- Users will earn less Victory Points for winning and lose more Victory Points for losing when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.

- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.

- Users in Bronze do not lose their Victory Points after losing.

- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted if they reach 1 or lower Victory Points below the required Victory Points of that League.

- 50 Victory Points will be deducted during the Settlement period if no match was played 48 hours after the last match, and 50 Victory Points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The Victory Points deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to 200 Victory Points or lower.

- Matches will be unavailable during the Victory Point Settlement period, between 00:00–11:00(UTC+9) every day.

- Rewards will be given based on the final Victory Points once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.


[h3][Unlimited Combat Environment][/h3]

- Only 10% of HP, ATK, and DEF increased from gears and growth applied.

- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit applied to SSR ships.

- Outgoing Healing Decrease reaches up to 80% depending on the remaining time.

notes.title: Notice on Postponement of Some Update Details Due to App Store Review Delay
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t5Df3OZ.png[/img]

Dear CEOs,

In the Patch Notes released on February 18, we informed you that the update includes new Awakened employee, Substream, and Awakened employee exclusive gears.

These new content updates require a new app update, and the development team prepared the update with the same schedule and method, as usual, to provide the new content to the CEOs without any problems.

However, the review of the new update on the App Store is currently somewhat delayed, making it inevitable to postpone the update of some content.

First of all, we apologize for not being able to immediately present all the content announced through the Patch Notes to the CEOs, regardless of the reasons for the review delay.

The content whose update is postponed due to today's review delay and the content that cannot be used due to this are as follows:

▣ Content not reflected due to review delay
[list][*]
Sprouting Star Solovey’s Awakened exclusive gears
[/*][*]
Substream, Winter Vacation Hard Mode
[/*][/list]
As the update related to the exclusive gears has been postponed, all stages of the Winter Vacation Hard Mode, where you can acquire the exclusive gears, will be unavailable until the app review is completed. 

※, Awakened employee, Substream, etc., can be accessed normally, but not the Awakened exclusive gear-related contents.
[list][*]
Fixes requiring the app update
[/*][/list][olist][*]
An issue where the management UI abnormally appears.
[/*][/olist]
The development team is working with the App Store through various methods to get the review results. When the app review is completed, we plan to make the postponed content available through temporary maintenance.

We will provide a separate notice regarding the temporary maintenance that will be conducted after the review is completed.

In addition, the list of Set Options for Solovey’s Awakened exclusive gears will change from what was announced in the Patch Notes on February 18.

▣ Sprouting Star Solovey Awakened Exclusive Gear

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6D8Wt5y.png[/img]

We apologize once again for not being able to provide all the announced update details immediately due to the review delay. We will take action to ensure that the review is completed as quickly as possible.

Thank you.

- Deployment Range Increase: All ally employees have increased deployment ranges. 

- Deployment Restrictions: Each employee can only be deployed 1 time.

- Hitstun Immunity: All enemy units gain Immunity to Hitstun 1 minute after the battle starts.

[h2]Championship: Beta[/h2]

1) Championship: Beta season will begin.

[h3]◆ Championship: Beta Schedule[/h3]
▷ Championship Period: Dec. 24, 2024, 14:00 - Jan. 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC-5)
▷ Settlement Period: Jan. 7, 20:00 -  Jan. 14, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-5)


[h3][ Information ][/h3]

- Users can compete with each other during the season, and matches are played after setting a Global Ban.

- Users will earn more points for winning and lose less points when matched against opponents with higher Victory Points.

- Users will earn less points for winning and lose more points when matched against opponents with lower Victory Points.

- Upper-tier Leagues are accessible after earning a certain amount of Victory Points.

- Users in certain Leagues can be demoted from their League if their Victory Points fall below 1.

- Forfeiting during a match will lead to a loss and more Victory Points will be deducted.

- Points will be deducted during the Settlement period if no match is played after 48 hours of the last match and points will be deducted every day thereafter, which may lead to League demotions. The point deduction rule will stop once a match is played during this period. The Victory Point deduction rule does not apply to points or lower.

- Matches will be unavailable during the point Settlement period, between 10:00 – 21:00 (UTC-5) every day.

- Rewards will be given based on the final score once the season ends and the Settlement period begins.


[h3][ Championship Combat Environment ][/h3]

- Only 10% of HP, ATK, DEF increased from gears and growth applied.

- CRIT DMG RES +50% and 20% Max DMG Taken Limit applied to SSR ships.

- Outgoing Healing Decrease reaches up to 80% depending on the remaining time.

[h2]▣ Gear & Set Option Ensured Selection System[/h2]
▷ Gear & Set Option Ensured Selection System will be implemented. 

◆ Ensured Selection System Activation Requirement 
- Using 500 of either Tuning or Set Binaries. 

[h3]【 Tuning Binary Example - How the System Works 】 [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ShieMJd.jpeg[/img]

1. Select the gear that you wish to change its option. 

2. Roll for the option you are after.
[list][*]
The mileage is purely based on the number of tuning binaries used, regardless of other factors.
[/*][/list]

3. If your mileage reaches 500 or above, you must press confirm on the current option section or cancel the roll by exiting the tuning screen to activate the [Option Selection].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VVYi7mS.jpeg[/img]

★☆★ Based on the option you have chosen, it will give you a different selection pop-up window. ★☆★

For example, since the above example selects [Option 1], pressing the [Confirm] will result in the following pop-up screen. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OH5BbJT.jpeg[/img]

As such, selecting [Option 2] like below will give you the corresponding selection screen. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hXVmfKa.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CO9MuHr.jpeg[/img]

4. After selecting your option and pressing the [Select] option, the following confirmation pop-up window will appear.

[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdxHiVrLX4YTNWnJ2sIDG6Eb1eZ8E69qWzMAgWCOpMvNAjVVVkaBCMiF5TClpls9mP2HRruEOsAC14v99DD9XR2Lfo3JxNhlkNbMIltc3DBP5MEbK6h1oNZoy-v2pFvVKjeAZmzkpY7ow3s92p8hjNEAy6D?key=B3cwYhK1l8_IwDOXHk3aOBWo[/img]

5. Selecting [OK] will give you the selected option for the gear.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hXVmfKa.jpeg[/img]

[h3][b]※ Tuning Binaries spent on Gear Precision will NOT count toward the mileage![/b][/h3]
 

[h3]【 Set Binary Example - How the System Works 】 [/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eS1eDhK.jpeg[/img]

1. Select the gear that you wish to change its set option. 

2. Roll for the option you are after.
[list][*]
The mileage is purely based on the number of set binaries used, regardless of other factors.
[/*][/list]

3. If your mileage reaches 500 or above, press confirm on the current option in the [To-be] section or cancel the roll by exiting the tuning screen to activate the [Set Selection].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XMVt0cz.jpeg[/img]

4. After selecting the [Confirm] above, the [Change] option will deactivate, and the [Set Selection] will be turned on.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/39ZrD1Q.jpeg[/img]

5. Selecting the [Confrim] option will trigger the following pop-up to appear.
※ Do keep in mind that you cannot select the set option that is already engraved in the gear.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KIgRjL6.jpeg[/img]

6. After selecting the set option you want and pressing the [Select] option, the following confirmation pop-up window will appear.
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeFy-nrf_WiHxMhtMMoiuMLywYBpFSq085AJUElkIQgIhM64mONu959txRN_jQL6qoJv9KiHbX6E1McAVuXP8feeVenvW4-L0-mUjARbb6YrqXlI-i7BqREpsrIKHt0bR-o4ZpQclVLuTNW0syhIJbq8jqO?key=B3cwYhK1l8_IwDOXHk3aOBWo[/img]

7. After selecting [OK] on the pop-up window, the selected set option will be engraved on the gear, and the mileage accumulation exceeding 500 at the activation point will be reflected in the cumulative count for the next activation.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JF14NAf.jpeg[/img]

[b]◆ Clearing Counter Pass[/b]
[list][*]
You can clear the Counter Pass Missions to increase the pass level while acquiring the necessary materials for unit growth.
[/*][*]
Counter Pass missions are divided into [Daily Mission] and [Weekly Missions].
[/*][*]
In the [Daily Mission], 10 missions are given daily; you can choose 6 from the 10 to clear the given mission.
[/*][list][*]
If you don't like the given mission, you can select the reroll option to renew it.
[/*][*]
You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.
[/*][*]
If you clear more than 6 missions, you can earn extra pass experience.
[/*][/list][*]
In the [Weekly Mission], 10 missions are given every Monday at 04:00 UTC-9.
[/*][list][*]
You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.
[/*][/list][*]
You can earn extra pass experience by completing 2nd and 4th-week missions.
[/*][/list]

[h2]▣ Observation Mode[/h2]
The feature can be used as the following.

[h3]◇ Method 1[/h3]

[olist][*]
A new [Create Room] option will be added to the [Friendly Match Options]. After finishing the options, you can create an observation room by selecting [Create Room].
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfLKSi_0ctQqRQY_WYb4UDHKQBTEVofY7Km7KcraT-LB33_4BSpPINgKttMaf8YSmokPaTloy_vvJXwDbXabUFnYcwk2_rn9q3DxoQD8KpxdWAQOZ1KdHtds1qkf9KgMn7amTZhTlMrndw6ARe7-MQtJPM?key=szlZbCaVYaRBsFmMR5iHNw[/img]
[/*][*]
The created observation room will be assigned a unique [Observation Code]. You can share this code with those who want to observe through other messaging apps.

[/*][*]
CEOs who receive the observation code can enter the [Friendly Match] as an observer after entering the code.
[/*][/olist]
 

◇ Method 2
[olist][*]
Create an observation room from the [Friendly Match Options] and [Create Room].


[/*][*]
Directly invite the opponent and observations from the [Partner] or the list of [Consortium Members].


[/*][*]
Once the opponent or observers accept the invitation, the opponent will be placed in the [Friendly Match] to prepare for the match, and the observers will be directed to an observation waiting room.
[/*][/olist]

Once all participants are ready and enter the match, a dedicated toggle button will be generated for observers.

By clicking the target toggle button, observers can switch between the perspectives of each competitor. The initial perspective will be the left-side competitor’s perspective.

Observers can leave the observation screen at any time during the match.

[h3]【 Beta Season 】[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sRdEpQk.png[/img] 

After the update, Squad Tournament’s Beta Season will begin. 
To register the squad for the tournament, you first need to [Form Squad].

Upon selecting the option, you are given a screen to do so. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2FLlhrs.png[/img] 
Fill in the slots with employees, ship, and an operator. 
Please remember that the tournament system will [b]automatically deploy from 1 to 8[/b].

When the change is made to the original formation, the [Changed] tag will display on top of each slot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rl8b98I.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7RLecxL.png[/img] 
Pressing the [Select] option will correctly apply the change to the original squad formation you have previously made.

- Excess [Rearmament Data] and [Prime Rearmament Data] can be exchanged for the following in the [Rearmament Data Exchange Center] under the [Seasonal] section.

[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcX4GFGHq8698rCr0ud8F0q34X89_MH63bHeM4Nw3l-x4EvideCzpvaSNFf7QLYb9spJ2uq1IV480ubAzeZP4C4dpy0HB3U5agPf_sL2sBxbe1L7pxz8nekFpHU-Xc-9zR8rEin53NJnNFq-9DqkUqbwCg?key=MEcLD3FZdcPHkDTJJ4bVcg[/img]

▼ Rearmamemnt Data Exchange Center Available Schedule
▷ September 4, After the maintenance ~ January 8, 2025, 14:00 (UTC+9)
▷ September 4, After the maintenance ~ January 8, 2025, 00:00 (UTC-5)


[b]◈ APT Core Unification[/b]

1. [Counter], [Solider], and [Mech] APT Cores will be unified to [APT Core].

2. [Counter], [Solider], and [Mech] S-APT Cores will be unified to [S-APT Core].

- All 3 types of APT Cores and S-APT Cores sold in the Business Card Shop and Substream Event Shops will also be replaced with the unified version.

3. [Today’s Deals] items will also be adjusted.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rCCNkXM.png[/img] 


[b]◈ Miscellaneous[/b]

1. In Dive, the level display for the squad will be changed to display the level of the ship.

2. The PC client will be improved to allow for the free adjustment of the length and width of the screen, both vertically and horizontally.

3. Shortcut keys for starting or skipping battles in certain contents will be added to the PC client.


■ Target
- World Map Raids
- Dives
- Dimension Trimming
- Shadow Palaces
- Co-op Battle

■ Hotkeys
- Battle Start / Skip: SPACE bar
- Confirm: Space / Enter / Keypad #5 key

4. Summons will now have a special icon displayed on their status bar.
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfqrmvGhQAGsTBVsrmqPoLBs2TJ5Xfctw8GyST-iHhZYd8jmeAIEpZ-TYGy0ezGE9RGZn1ADwujLh2yIoyO6Y1ZhdpFiak7M9omQq8u-f-76mdwh8HKdBDMX2wd8sg2l6c4EPGNlJak-HmJwSlai8abstGo?key=MEcLD3FZdcPHkDTJJ4bVcg[/img]

5. A spoiler prevention function will be added to the Substream Event Shops.
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf16g9eT-JuqGARlOiHJ4DsMderxq9sNjIKelnPxJS1hAZK7i60BhrcKWTl-4u4rYkIWLEkhgVnZjnFp_dv-drbZ23hGPkImpvj_rJzU8jN5ORMAvxXXEVKUyJ9kRLhgRaBzTHLyQCWlrIeVaPbgJql3Uhg?key=MEcLD3FZdcPHkDTJJ4bVcg[/img]


[h2][b]▣ Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

1. A fix where ascending and descending order filter functions for some trophies are not working as intended in the [Main Employee] tab in the [Profile Settings].

2. A fix where the Danger Close ranking is shown as 100% even though there is no record of defeating the boss.

3. A fix where [Garguantia Maria Antonov]’s portal is created incorrectly upon her deployment. 

4. A fix where Milia Rage's Special Skill, [Septem Voices], targets an abnormal target sporadically.

5. A fix where casting Ministra's Special Skill after unlocking level 2 Alternium Reactor would cause the opponent to trigger a basic attack counterattack.

6. A fix where after purchasing all the [Contest] emotes, a notification dot would still appear.

7. A fix where Fury employees’ cooldown time scale is written in [seconds], not [times] when selecting the skill while trying to switch employees in the PVP screen.

[b]9. Outgoing Healing Decrease (2nd):[/b] All units are inflicted with Outgoing Healing -80% 3 minutes 30 seconds after the battle starts. 

[b]10. DMG Increase: [/b]Enemy units' damage increases by 100% 4 minutes after the battle starts.

5. Damage Increase/Decrease Effect Based on Distance

Before: Only melee effects applied for distances 500 or less, and only ranged effects applied for distances exceeding 500.

After: Effects will gradually increase or decrease based on distance, with 500 as the reference point.

Example: At a distance of 500 or less, melee effects will be applied at 100%. As the distance increases beyond 500, the melee effects will gradually decrease.

Note: In areas where both melee and ranged effects are applied, only the higher final value between the distance-adjusted melee and ranged effects will be applied. 

Example:

◎ Unit Damage Stats vs Damage amount

 vs. melee damage 10% / vs. ranged damage 20%


◎ Damage application ratio based on current location

vs. melee damage 100% / vs. ranged damage 84%


◎Final damage after applying ratio

vs. melee damage 10% / vs. ranged damage 16.8%


Final applied effect: Only vs. ranged damage 16.8% is applied.

notes.title: Jack-O's SD Unit Motion Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JVzi187.png[/img] 

Dear CEOs,

This is Kim Hyun Soo, the Head PD of CounterSide.

We sincerely apologize for the recent changes to the motions of Scales of Juno Jack-O’s SD unit, a limited-time Awakened employee from the ongoing GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- collaboration, without prior notice that was implemented in the data patch released on June 14th (Fri). The affected motions, which were updated in the data patch, include two animations: movement and attack.

As part of our collaboration with the IP holder, we must obtain their approval for using their intellectual property in the game. This includes submitting all game assets for their review and approval.

During the GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- collaboration in 2024, we discovered that the two motions for Jack-O’s SD unit were omitted from the resource asset review. These unreviewed assets cannot be used in the game as explained, so the two motions were removed via the data patch.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience and concern this may have caused to our CEOs. We should have informed you in advance about the situation and the reason for the motion changes.

Fortunately, ARC SYSTEM WORKS, the IP holder for GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-, has graciously agreed to review the previously omitted motions for Jack-O’s SD unit. The two motions that were removed from the game are now under review by the IP holder. Once it is complete, we plan to reimplement those motions in the game through a separate patch.

Please note that the reviewed motions may differ slightly from the originally implemented versions or may be replaced with alternatives. We will provide detailed information about any such changes in the patch notes.

We also extend our sincerest apologies to CEOs who have been eagerly awaiting the GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- collaboration for a year, only to be met with this unforeseen delay. To express our sorry for the inconvenience, we have prepared the following compensation.

[b]▣ Compensation[/b]
▷ Content: 1,000 Quartz
▷ Delivery Schedule: June 19, 2024, at 00:10 (UTC-5)
▷ Expiration Date: June 26, 2024, at 00:00 (UTC-5)

We sincerely apologize for the development team's inadequate handling of the collaboration that was supposed to be enjoyable. We will work with ARC SYSTEM WORKS to quickly resolve the motion change issue. 

Thank you.

[h2][b]▣ Improvements and Changes[/b][/h2]
1. Set or Latent option gear selector coupons will now have a lock option enabled right after selecting the gear.

2. Gauntlet surrender function is added. 
[list][*]
You can find the function in the Strategy and Ranked Battle, Friendly Match, and Arcade.
[/*][*]
You can activate this function 20 seconds after the match has begun.
[/*][*]
When you select the function, it will result in an immediate loss.
[/*][/list]

3. Story cut-scenes with Betty Mitch will change to her live illustration.

4. The [Mission] tab will now have [Title] & [Trophy] tabs.
[list][*]
All the achievements with Titles and Trophies will be relocated to their respective tab. 
[/*][/list]

5. Raid support function improvement will take place.
[list][*]
Additional information on the Branch where the raid occurred and who the Branch Manager is.
[/*][*]
Information of the discoverer’s consortium information.
[/*][*]
Added functionality to confirm whether the raid discoverer is a partner or a consortium member.
[/*][*]
Addition of sorting functionality.
[/*][*]
Option to support all existing raid has been added.
[/*][/list]
  * You can sort raids by level and remaining time.

  * Raids from the previous season will be sorted to the bottom regardless of the sorting function.

6. World Map Branch switch function
[list][*]
After getting into a certain Branch’s interface, you can now swipe sideways to go to the next branch without selecting the other branch.
[/*][/list]

7. Completed Taskforce Plans will move to the bottom, pushing unstarted or ongoing plans to appear at the top. 

8. The Gauntlet season point shop will now have 5 more awakened frames added to the list.

9. Two BGM’s will be added.
[list][*]
Throw Down The Gauntlet
[/*][*]
Execution of the Tyrant
[/*][/list]

[h2][b]▣ Fixes[/b][/h2]

1. Fixed an issue where the filter in the Workshop-Craft would display the old UI. 

2. Fixed an issue where if you equip a title with an effect and switch to another account, the effect from the previous account would display. 

3. Fixed an issue where the displaying currency icons would overlap spontaneously. 

4. Fixed an issue where the employee negotiations would not proceed as intended spontaneously. 

5. Fixed an issue where the Guide Mission was not being updated with the Co-Op battle content. 

6. Fixed an issue where if you level up Operators, some display resolutions would not show as intended.

2. Dimension Trimming titles will be added

- CEOs who cleared the Dimension Trimming before the rework will be given a title with special effect.



[h2][b]▣ Origin System - Stability[/b][/h2]

1) New Origin, Stability, has been added. 

▷ This system will only be applied to the PVE contents. 

▷ The [Origin] system will be given to units / NPCs and they may receive multiple types of [Origin].

▷ Units with [Origin] of a certain type can output more damage to the opponents of that same [Origin] as well as receive less damage. 

★ Increased amount of damage and damage reduction depends on the rarity of the unit.

▷ Awakened: 40% increased damage to & 30% damage reduction from the opponent with the same [Origin].

▷ SSR: 30% increased damage to & 20% damage reduction from the opponent with the same [Origin].

▷ SR: 10% increased damage to & 10% damage reduction from the opponent with the same [Origin].

▷ Summoned: 20% increased damage to & 20% damage reduction from the opponent with the same [Origin].
[list][*]
(All summoned beings will have the same Origin stat regardless of their summoner’s rarity.)
[/*][/list]
- Damage increase from the [Origin] is a [Group 4] stat, completely independent from Groups 1 ~ 3. For more about the stat grouping, please refer to this developer’s note.
[list][*]
[url=https://www.counterside.com/notice/item/ct/en/tbl/notice/idx/326/P3]Link[/url]
[/*][/list]
- Damage increase to & damage reduction from will not affect if the opponent does not have an [Origin] or different [Origin]. 

- You can check the unit’s [Origin] from the [Unit Info].
- You can check units with the [Origin] in the [Managment].

The employees with the Stability are as follows.

[h2][b]▣ Raid: Inhibitor Season[/b][/h2]

ex) HP +320 / HP +32%

1. A fix where the Alternium Reactor’s UI would sporadically appear abnormal.

a. FLEX-!

※ The expenditure count starts from Feb. 8, 2023, after the service transfer.

▷ The total sum of the same item from the completed dispatch missions will be displayed to the player. 

■ The focusing effect from the dive and raid after completing the dispatch mission will be removed.

■ [CSE Passive Raidar] facility will be removed.
▷ Points and Credit used to establish this facility will be refunded in full.
▷ Requirements for [Spatial Coordinates Fixator] and [Phased Array Radar]’s construction requirement will be removed.

■ The issue of reducing the great success rate upon reaching level 10 on the branch will be fixed.

■ Upon selecting the [Exchange Center] in the World Map will now directly transfer to the [Exchange - Dive].

■ If all the dispatch missions are completed, a push will be sent to your mobile device.
 ※ If the dispatch missions were sent from the Steam client, the completion push message will not be sent to your mobile device. 

▷ This push option will work upon enabling the [Notification - All Dispatch missions completed] option.

[h2][b]▣ Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

1. A fix where the Title for [ Police SWAT 4 ] is not acquirable even after getting the necessary employees to get it.

2. A fix where Naielle Bluesteel’s Immune to DMG buff is immediately removed when she uses an enhanced basic attack right after her Special Skill.

3. A fix on Edel Meitner’s voice on Swift Trimming Trinity. 

4. A fix on the battle conditions of the co-op battle where it was not being displayed as intended.

5. A fix where background images that are no longer available are included in the Background Collectables.

[b]◆ Clearing Counter Pass[/b]
[list][*]
You can clear the Counter Pass Missions to increase the pass level while acquiring the necessary materials for unit growth.
[/*][*]
Counter Pass missions are divided into [Daily Mission] and [Weekly Missions].
[/*][*]
In the [Daily Mission], 10 missions are given daily; you can choose 6 from the 10 to clear the given mission.
[/*][list][*]
If the given mission is not up to your taste, you can select the reroll option to renew the mission.
[/*][*]
You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.
[/*][*]
If you clear more than 6 missions, you can earn extra pass experience.
[/*][/list][*]
In the [Weekly Mission], 10 missions are given every Monday at 04:00 UTC-9.
[/*][list][*]
You can re-roll the mission for free for the first 3 times, and up to 5 more times afterward by spending credits.
[/*][/list][*]
You can earn extra pass experience by completing 2nd and 4th-week missions.
[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/FZDGJAd3x1QbhaAh45fJAlvXle1-ixqR2VAOqBeXmAvbVXQbgn1BgWG7o3c1GxSnzzPAqz99uIFfzSKgu-OcUbrDzEZsbLmwzNAO0zVNaiaUWB0MdeG3tlCA6oQCDfZiB9I1SW8DpLkOjJdCcg1k_PU[/img]

Dear CEOs,
This is Kim Hyun Soo, the Head PD of CounterSide.

In relation to the October update content introduced through the last developer's notes, we would like to share information regarding the current progress of development.

[h3][b][ Gauntlet ][/b][/h3]

[b]1. Damage Increase Based on Remaining Time[/b]

As previously mentioned in the developer's notes, our development team has observed that the average combat time for Gentlet has become too long. 

As such, we applied the effect of damage increase by +100% & +200% damage when 1 min 30s & 1 min remain respectively. 

However, due to concerns about the excessiveness of this effect, the implementation has been removed through a recent patch. 

Currently, the development team is testing a revised effect where damage increases by +30% & +60% damage when 1 min 30s & 1 min remain respectively. 

Additionally, we are working on a feature to remove the threshold break exclusively for Gauntlet. After the completion, we plan to test it alongside the damage +30% / +60% effect. 

We will ensure that the application of the damage increase is thoroughly tested to provide a better experience.


[b]2. Rotation UP Unit Selection Rules[/b]

Here are the rules for selecting Gentlet's rotation UP units. 

The primary criteria for selecting UP units is that the unit has to win a Ranked Match at least once within the last two weeks from the point of UP unit selection. The units in the rotation & casting bans are excluded from the UP list along with the collaboration units.

Among the selected units meeting the first criteria (only including SR/SSR rarity) above, the system will then randomly choose four units from the lower 50% of those with the lowest number of victories.

We hope that this explanation clarifies any curiosities and doubts about the rules for selecting rotation UP units.


[h3][b][Contest Skin - Ministra ][/b][/h3]

We are currently working on the contest skin for Ministra, the winner of the skin contest held in February. 

This skin will not only be for Ministra but also for the variant Spira that Ministra summons.

Dear CEOs, 
On October 18, 2023, an update on the CounterSide Private Policy is planned. 
Please refer below for more details.

[b]■ Details[/b]
- Update Target:  CounterSide Privacy Policy
- Update Date (Effective Date): October 18, 2023
- Update Content


[h3][b]<8.4 Right to erasure> - Additional Content[/b][/h3]

- Open ID means a piece of personal information that is created from social platform login information (Facebook, Google, Apple, X (ex Twitter), etc.). The Company stores all Open IDs in an encrypted format to prevent any inappropriate uses.

① The User can request the deletion of the Open ID via in-game help, the Official Customer Center, or help email (help_cs@studiobisde.com).

② Every Open ID requested for deletion will be processed within 30 days starting from the day of the request.

[list]
[*] If you do not express your refusal by the effective date of the revised Privacy Policy, you will be considered to have agreed to the revised content.
[*] If you do not agree to the revised Privacy Policy, you can apply for 'Account Deletion’ or raise objections through the [url=https://counterside.com/customer][Customer Center][/url]. However, please be aware that when you delete your account, all game information, including characters and items in your possession, will be permanently deleted, and this cannot be recovered.
[*] For inquiries regarding the revised Privacy Policy, please contact the[url=https://counterside.com/customer] [Customer Center][/url].
[/list]

#1. Where I am is the MacCready Estate.


#2. Knowledge is power. In the wrong hands, power brings blood. Preventing any avoidable bloodshed from happening... That is the reason why I decided to take on the role of President.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/56rlGZKmYWeSyGXN5YcUWgRo1qSMDbzloR7vHZRFXHXVKnFcU-rOQfvoqu62qIqLSmSKmQvk9cTitZ3oQAeKcpcvhinfrs-efUuY9TPfaRG11-qlavFv8L1UiilKD_MiQcE06wlsBWopBULLa5N0wwc[/img] 

8) The infinite sign on the crafting molds will be deleted.   

9) A total of 8 interactive voices between awakened employees are added.

- When certain awakened employees are deployed to the battlefield, they will use a different dialogue under certain conditions.  

10) The button for Danger Close is added to the main lobby screen. 

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/HrkZCFVaKyQSLPiVv2eVd7kEibdR4cnUr6Do9WtcjeDN4wpR-nxtDTayR7-VFAK2Wi914rUDJ1eMcRcNawVOWUQLVsMVjMd_BdgdejoP8zdgT5KzZE8m15g4tMpTZ9e1jARyKlI-Fh-BtXHKGLs7J2M[/img]
